description: Dump the accessibility (UI) tree of the current screen of an installed iOS or Android app — the inspection primitive (like Playwright's snapshot). Returns {screenTitle, elements:[{type,id,label,enabled,hittable,x,y,w,h}]}. Use it to see what's on screen before/after acting.

androidAppId.description: Android application id of the installed app

appBundleId.description: iOS bundle id of the installed app

name: tapp_ui_tree
title: Inspect screen (a11y tree)
